描述_EN: within the border is a four-corner design, each corner containing a chinese lion and a central dragon medallion. the rest of the rug is of knotted silk pile. the corners and medallion are worked in metallic threads in the weft-wrap weave technique known as soumak. rug with a yellow ground and a stylised floral pattern with a key fret border in blue, white and red. there is a short unread inscription woven into one end.
描述_ZN: 边框内有一个四角设计，每个角都有一个中国狮子和一个中央的龙形徽章。 地毯的其余部分是打结的丝绸绒毛。 角落和奖章是用金属线在被称为Soumak的纬线编织技术中加工的。 瓦楞纸以黄色为底，以蓝、白、红三色为基调的花纹为边框的造型。 有一个短的未读的铭文编织在一端。
